name: Isabella Valencia
bio:
Isabella's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a deep fascination with the artistry and precision of automotive design. Originally pursuing a degree in fine arts, she found herself increasingly drawn to the technical aspects of vehicle aesthetics, particularly paint application and custom finishes. A chance encounter with a local racing team led to an apprenticeship, where she honed her skills and developed a keen eye for detail. 

Now a vital member of the Stake Sauber team, Isabella approaches her role with unwavering dedication. She believes that a flawlessly executed paint job is more than just cosmetic; it's a reflection of the team's commitment to excellence and can subtly influence a car's aerodynamic performance. Her perfectionist tendencies, coupled with her creative flair, ensure that every car leaving her paint shop is a work of art, ready to make a statement on the track. What sets Isabella apart is her ability to blend artistic vision with technical expertise, creating bespoke finishes that are both visually stunning and aerodynamically optimized.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a high ponytail during work.
physical.description: Isabella is of medium height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using only natural light to inspect paint finishes.
Always listens to classical music while working.
Has a collection of miniature paintbrushes that she uses for detailing.
